# The Oberdorfer Team

> A husband-and-wife real estate team led by Brandon and Kaitlyn Oberdorfer, serving buyers and sellers across Massachusetts. The team operates under REWAP Brokerage LLC. Phone: 406-250-7620. Promise: "Luxury at every price point."

Facts on this site are sourced and dated. Market figures are for Wakefield, Massachusetts only (Redfin, accessed October 10, 2026) and are not live. Listings on this prototype are demonstrations.
